scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You got rid of Bangungot!
The nurse might be waiting for you
in front of the hospital!
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
你消滅了噩夢死神般滾勾特！
護士可能在醫院門口等你！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
..........

[Nurse Maenne]
Now the entrance
to go up second floor
is closed.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
現在通往二樓的入口已經關閉了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
To go up
the second floor again
Open the gate
after lapse of time.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
想要再次上二樓，
請在時間流逝後開啟大門。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
From the Bangungot at second floor
You returned safely to here!!
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
你從二樓的噩夢死神般滾勾特那裡
安全地回到了這裡！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
If you want to go up
second floor again
Please come to me.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
如果你想再次上二樓，
請再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
.......

[Nurse Maenne]
.....?
Now you can't go up
to the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
.....?
現在你無法上二樓了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
This is fatal situation.
that is why you can't go up
2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
這是致命的情況。
這就是為什麼你無法上二樓。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
To the second floor of hospital
Do you want go up second floor again?
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
醫院二樓
你想再次上二樓嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You have too much stuff.
Please reduce your stuff and
come to me again.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
你的物品太多了。
請減少物品數量，
然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It's too heavy.
Please reduce the weight and
come to me again.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
太重了。
請減輕重量，
然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
.......

[Nurse Maenne]
- The door is closed to 1st floor
when this Nurse came in?
I call her behind but
She doesn't respond. -
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
- 當我進來時，通往一樓的門是關著的？
我喊她，
但她沒有回應。 -

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You returned safely from the Bangungot on the second floor!!
However, it's not
really over yet.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
你從二樓的噩夢死神般滾勾特那裡安全回來了！！
但是，
事情還沒有真正結束。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I'm pretty sure it
never disappears easily.
I don't know what will happen
about Bangungot, so
after a lapse of time
please return to me.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
我很確定它不會輕易消失。
我不知道噩夢死神般滾勾特會發生什麼，
所以在時間流逝後，
請回來找我。

scripts.text:
- I guess...
I can't talk him alone.
After registering a party
let me try to say something. -
scripts.translation:
- 我想...
我無法單獨和他說話。
組建隊伍後，
讓我試著說點什麼。 -

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You are back...
There is bad news.
I heard that
the Bangungot is appeared
again.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
你回來了...
有個壞訊息。
我聽說
噩夢死神般滾勾特又出現了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I already heard that story so
I pretty much know that.
What are you going to do?
Do you want to go up
to the second floor?
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
我已經聽過那個故事了，
所以我很清楚。
你打算怎麼做？
你想上二樓嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
{0} 's help
is needed again.
Please could you give me
one more chance?
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
{0} 大人，
我又需要您的幫助了。
請再給我一次機會，好嗎？

scripts.text: Enter the second floor.
scripts.translation: 進入二樓

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要進入

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
A critical situation has happened.
You can't go up to the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
發生了緊急情況。
您現在不能上二樓。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
We are preparing to go up
to the second floor.
At the second floor
there is a chaotic rumor that
the dead do not die.
Please refer to this story.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
我們正在準備前往二樓。
二樓流傳著一個混亂的謠言，
說死者不會死去。
請查閱這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
When you finish everything,
please talk to me again.
I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
完成所有事情後，
請再回來找我。
真的非常感謝您。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
A critical situation has happened.
You can't go up to the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
發生了緊急情況。
您現在不能上二樓。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You can't go up to
the 2nd floor now.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
您現在不能上二樓。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It's too dangerous to go
up to the 2nd floor alone.
Please come here with
several people.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
獨自上二樓太危險了。
請帶上幾個人一起來。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Alright.
If you change mind, come back again.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
好的。
如果您改變主意，請再回來。
